code:
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/someone/their-skills /tmp/their-skills
less /tmp/their-skills/skills/commit-tidy/SKILL.md     # read it BEFORE it is installed
ls /tmp/their-skills/skills/commit-tidy/scripts        # and read anything executable
mkdir -p .agents/skills
cp -r /tmp/their-skills/skills/commit-tidy .agents/skills/
description: A five-line recipe that clones a skills repository shallowly, reads the skill before installing it, and copies out the one directory you want.

steps.description: This recipe installs one skill from a repository that holds many. It clones shallowly into a scratch directory and copies out the single skill directory.
`git clone --depth 1` fetches only the latest revision, which is enough when you want one skill.

The middle two lines are the point of the detour. Line 2 reads the `SKILL.md`, and line 3 lists the `scripts/` directory so you can read anything executable. A skill can tell the agent to run what is in there.
`mkdir -p .agents/skills` creates the discovery path, and `cp -r` copies the skill directory into it.

steps.question: When you read a skill before installing it, what do you read?

title: Installing One Skill from a Repository
